_about: Two-Key Ledger mission nodes (mission-framework TKL). Mission part only: validate with the Tallow Wharf map graph, `node scripts/level-validate.mjs <abs>/campaign-map/graph.json <abs>/two-key-ledger/graph.json` (mission-validator branch). Space ids are the map's (campaign-map/graph.json). Beat chart: BEAT.md; id mapping and choices: BEAT.md 'Graph notes'. `window` (tkl-3) and `item` (tkl-4) are MissionDef fields kept for EN2, not validator fields.

objectives.text: Listen to the night clerk on his supper break in the pie shop loft
objectives.hint: The night clerk eats in the pie shop loft. Listen from the loft walkway outside.

objectives.text: Into the counting house: the east gate by the yard, the west wing from the roof
objectives.hint: The founding year is on the brass plate over the front door. The east gate takes it.

objectives.text: Turn both strongroom keys together: the east wing and the west wing key posts
objectives.hint: Each of you holds a key. Turn when the count says turn, not before.

objectives.text: Take the ledger from the strongroom and leave by the coal chute to the yard
objectives.hint: The coal chute is in the strongroom passage. One boosts, the other crawls out by the yard hatch and unbars the coal yard door.

objectives.text: Optional: copy the partners' day book in the east wing office
objectives.hint: The partners' office is one door from the east key post. Its desk lamp is the warm one.

objectives.text: Both of you, through the wharf sheds to the boat at the jetty steps
objectives.hint: The boat waits at the jetty steps under the crane. The shed shutter is the way through.
